name: Database health
summary: Surface slow queries, unused indexes, bloat, and long transactions

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: HEALTH_SLOW_QUERY_MS
env.description: Mean execution time above which a statement is recorded.

env.name: HEALTH_BLOAT_WARN_PCT
env.description: Dead-tuple percentage that triggers a finding.

env.name: HEALTH_MIN_TABLE_BYTES
env.description: Ignore objects smaller than this. Percentages on tiny tables are noise, and reporting them buries the real findings.

env.name: HEALTH_SNAPSHOT_RETENTION_DAYS
env.description: How long snapshots are kept for trend comparison.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating trigger delivery. Neon does not sign trigger POSTs.

env.name: HEALTH_PARENT_DATABASE_URL
env.description: Direct connection string for the parent branch, enabling schema-drift detection. Optional.

triggers.description: Take a daily snapshot and record findings. One reading shows what is slow; a series shows what got slower.

operations.title: POST /snapshot
operations.description: Cron. Take a snapshot and record findings.

operations.title: GET /trends
operations.description: Statements whose mean time is rising.

operations.title: GET /health
operations.description: Liveness and readiness, backed by the block's v_status view.
